text:
emma-sec: Quick heads-up  coordinated disclosure received for a subtle SAML metadata parsing issue that can cause external entity fetches when metadata auto-sync is enabled (internal ref SEC-14567). Affects Private and some Dedicated setups.

chris-sre: Can you confirm scope? Hosted customers impacted?

emma-sec: Hosted API is NOT impacted. Inventory: ~8 Dedicated tenants + 6 Private installs have `saml.sync.enabled=true`. I attached the list to the ticket.

ops-bot: SEC-14567 created: https://tickets.redwood-internal/SEC-14567 :rotating_light: Patch candidates are being validated.

samir-dev: Suggested immediate mitigation: flip the sync flag off, publish patched importer image, and schedule cert rotation for any auto-imported federation certs.

emma-sec: Agreed. Proposed timeline: T+1h disable sync; T+12h canary with patched image `redwood/saml-importer:2.6.4-fix`; T+48h full rollout; cert rotation window 72h after patch.

chris-sre: Disable commands for Dedicated control plane:

chris-sre: ```bash
kubectl -n redwood-system patch configmap saml-config -p '{"data":{"sync_enabled":"false"}}'
```

chris-sre: Helm for on-prem: `helm upgrade --set saml.sync.enabled=false redwood-private ./chart`

lena-cs: I'll draft customer advisory. Need an opt-in for assisted patching + opt-out language for customers doing their own on-prem upgrades.

monica-legal: Please include compliance wording for regulated customers and an internal contact for expedited reviews. Also, avoid saying "no evidence of compromise" unless we've completed telemetry sweep.

emma-sec: Noted. We'll say "no confirmed exploitation observed at time of notification" and run telemetry sweep for external metadata fetches in the last 90 days.

samir-dev: Canary policy idea: 2% low-traffic pools -> monitor `saml.fetch.external` logs and `auth.fail` for 90 minutes -> 20% -> 100%. Rollback via previous image tag.

chris-sre: I'll run the disable on the highest-risk tenants now and post which tenant IDs.

ops-bot: Patch image built: `redwood/saml-importer:2.6.4-fix` (signed). CI pipeline queued for canary.

lena-cs: Draft customer copy (short):

lena-cs: "Security advisory: Redwood released a patch for a SAML metadata parsing issue affecting Private installs and some Dedicated configurations using metadata auto-sync. We recommend disabling metadata auto-sync immediately and applying the patch. Reply with your account ID to request Redwood-run remediation"

monica-legal: Add contact for legal/security review and an option for customers to request a cert rotation performed by Redwood.

emma-sec: Action items: Emma  coordinate comms & telemetry sweep; Chris  disable sync + run canary; Samir  validate patch and prepare rollback; Lena  customer messaging; Monica  legal review.

chris-sre: Disabled sync on tenants: tenant-57, tenant-141, tenant-212. Posting status in SEC-14567.

emma-sec: After rollout we'll produce a short internal incident summary and a follow-up postmortem within 7 days. If anyone finds suspicious federation fetches, escalate to #incidents and tag me. :shield:
